[[File:Slum_district_G17_map.png|thumb|left|The [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]' map of slum district G17.]]
'''Slum district G17''' was an area of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] that contained, among other things, the [[Spider Arms Hostel/Legends|Spider Arms Hostel]], several [[Cabaret/Legends|Cabarets]], at least two [[Noodle Bar/Legends|Noodle Bar]] diners, [[Chezdeze/Legends|Chezdeze]], [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]],<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">The building where Trueping's is located, is the same one seen in this district in "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," right before [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] says, "This isn't happening". Even the crates around the corner are the same.</ref> [[Galaxy Noodles/Legends|Galaxy Noodles]], a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]], a gangster hangout, a gun market, and a bar in which [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] apprehended the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] criminal [[Car Affa/Legends|Car Affa]].
